description: This file defines the InputValidationMiddleware class, which is responsible for validating required input parameters for AWS commands within the AWS SDK PHP client. It includes methods to create middleware wrappers, constructor setup, and invocation logic for parameter validation.

classes.name: InputValidationMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that validates required input parameters for AWS commands to ensure they are non-empty.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: A static method that creates a middleware wrapper function, validating the mandatory attribute list and returning a closure that instantiates the middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler, service, and mandatory attributes list.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to validate the command's input parameters against the required attributes before passing to the next handler.
